# Apiframe Docs

> Official API reference for Apiframe: one REST API and MCP server for 70+ image, video, and music models.

Base URL is `https://api.apiframe.ai/v2`. Authenticate with header `X-API-Key: afk_...`. Every generation call returns a job id; poll `GET /v2/jobs/{id}` or register a webhook. Official SDK: `npm i @apiframe-ai/sdk@next` (Node.js / TypeScript only). Remote MCP server: `https://mcp.apiframe.ai`.

Each docs page is also served as Markdown at the same path with a `.mdx` suffix (the links below). For a single-file dump of every page, use https://apiframe.ai/docs/llms-full.txt. Product overview, pricing, and marketing pages: https://apiframe.ai/llms.txt.

## Overview
- [Introduction](https://apiframe.ai/docs.mdx): One API for image, video, and music generation. Every frontier model, one key.

## Getting Started
- [Authentication](https://apiframe.ai/docs/getting-started/authentication.mdx): How to authenticate with the Apiframe API using API keys.

## Image Generation
- [Image Generation](https://apiframe.ai/docs/images.mdx): Generate images using a variety of models through a single unified endpoint.
- [Flux 2 Pro](https://apiframe.ai/docs/images/flux/flux-2-pro.mdx): High-quality image generation and editing with multi-reference support.
- [Flux 2 Dev](https://apiframe.ai/docs/images/flux/flux-2-dev.mdx): Quality image generation and editing with open weights and reference image support.
- [Seedream 4](https://apiframe.ai/docs/images/seedream/seedream-4.mdx): High-resolution image generation and editing with multi-reference support by ByteDance.
- [Seedream 5.0 Pro](https://apiframe.ai/docs/images/seedream/seedream-5-pro.mdx): ByteDance's flagship text-to-image and editing model with sharp 1K/2K output and up to 10 reference images.
- [Ideogram Character](https://apiframe.ai/docs/images/ideogram/ideogram-character.mdx): Character-consistent image generation with reference image support and tiered rendering speed.
- [Kling Image](https://apiframe.ai/docs/images/kling-image/kling-image.mdx): Kling's image generation model with text-to-image and image editing via reference images.

## Video Generation
- [Video Generation](https://apiframe.ai/docs/videos.mdx): Generate videos using a variety of models through a single unified endpoint.
- [Grok Video](https://apiframe.ai/docs/videos/grok-imagine-video.mdx): Generate videos from text prompts and reference images using xAI's Grok Video model.
- [Happy Horse 1.1](https://apiframe.ai/docs/videos/happyhorse/happyhorse-1-1.mdx): Alibaba Happy Horse 1.1 — text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video (up to 9 images) with stronger motion, character consistency, and synced audio.
- [Hailuo 03](https://apiframe.ai/docs/videos/hailuo/hailuo-03.mdx): Generate 768p or native 2K video with synchronized audio from text, frames, or reference media using MiniMax H3.
- [Kling 4.0](https://apiframe.ai/docs/videos/kling/kling-4-0.mdx): Kling 4.0 — unified text/keyframe/reference-to-video and video editing, 3–30s at 720p/1080p with native audio.
- [Kling 4.0 Flash](https://apiframe.ai/docs/videos/kling/kling-4-0-flash.mdx): Kling 4.0 Flash — the fast 720p tier of Kling 4.0, 3–20s with the same unified reference and editing inputs.
- [Kling 3.0 Omni](https://apiframe.ai/docs/videos/kling/kling-3-0-omni.mdx): Kling 3.0 Omni — unified text/image/reference-to-video model with video editing, native audio, and multi-shot timelines.
- [Kling 3.0 Motion Control](https://apiframe.ai/docs/videos/kling/kling-3-0-motion-control.mdx): Kling 3.0 Motion Control — transfer motion from a reference video onto a character image.
- [Veo 3.1](https://apiframe.ai/docs/videos/veo/veo-3-1.mdx): Google Veo 3.1 — advanced video generation with audio, reference images, and last-frame control.
- [Veo 3.1 Fast](https://apiframe.ai/docs/videos/veo/veo-3-1-fast.mdx): Google Veo 3.1 Fast — faster video generation with audio, reference images, and last-frame control.
- [Wan 2.7 R2V](https://apiframe.ai/docs/videos/wan/wan-2-7-r2v.mdx): Reference-driven video generation with Wan 2.7 — guide motion, subjects, or style with up to five reference images and videos.
